title: Heimdall contracts v1
description: Single schema source for Heimdall V1 contract primitives and error vocabulary (T002). Generated TypeScript and OpenAPI components derive from this file; never edit generated output. Request/result composition belongs to later tasks (T005+).

requestId.title: RequestId
requestId.description: Opaque gateway request identifier. No task-ID fields exist in V1; taskId/task_id/taskID are rejected as unknown properties.

decisionId.title: DecisionId
decisionId.description: Identifier for one routing decision, not a task.

attemptId.title: AttemptId
attemptId.description: Identifier for one model invocation attempt within a decision.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter uppercase currency code (ISO-4217-shaped). A full allowlist is deferred to real price ingestion (T032).

decimalAmount.title: DecimalAmount
decimalAmount.description: Exact decimal money string. Binary floats are never used for billing arithmetic.

money.title: Money
money.description: Exact money value with declared currency.

tokenCount.title: TokenCount
tokenCount.description: Non-negative exact token count. Values above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER are rejected as unsafe.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC3339 date-time string with bounded length. The pattern checks field ranges (month, day, hour, minute, second, offset); impossible calendar dates such as February 30 pass the shape check and are a consumer concern.

applicationProfile.title: ApplicationProfile
applicationProfile.description: Required caller application profile. Coding agents retain models per task; chat and RAG route per invocation.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: All V1-declared modalities. Presence in the contract is not proof of runtime support; adapters advertise verified support only.

executionCertainty.title: ExecutionCertainty
executionCertainty.description: How certain Heimdall is that a billable provider call executed. A lost connection never proves zero cost.

errorCode.title: ErrorCode
errorCode.description: Typed gateway error vocabulary. Unknown codes fail validation by design; consumers handle them by upgrading, not guessing.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Reserved forward-compatibility object. No keys are allowed in v1; each future key is an additive minor version change. Unknown keys are rejected, never silently dropped.

textBlock.title: TextBlock
textBlock.description: Plain text content. The only modality with first-slice runtime support; others are expressible but rejected by adapters until verified.

urlSource.title: UrlSource
urlSource.description: External content reference by URL. Server-side fetching, if ever needed, is allowlisted per adapter; no fetching exists in v1.

refSource.title: RefSource
refSource.description: Caller-held content reference. The gateway never dereferences it; adapters declare what they accept.

imageBlock.title: ImageBlock
imageBlock.description: Image requirement. A description never erases the hard requirement to support the image itself.

fileBlock.title: FileBlock
fileBlock.description: File/document requirement (text, PDF, archive, or other opaque document).

mixedBlock.title: MixedBlock
mixedBlock.description: Bounded mixed-modality content. Depth beyond nesting limits is rejected.

contentBlock.title: ContentBlock
contentBlock.description: Any single content block across all declared modalities.

heimdallError.title: HeimdallError
heimdallError.description: Typed error envelope. Certainty is per-occurrence, never inferred from the code alone.
